Project — status check from Conroy (via Clawd).

Some things happened since last session (2026-04-05):

1. The repo was extracted to reification-labs/iex-claw on GitHub.
2. GitHub Actions CI was set up.
3. First PR was merged.

That means TDD guardrails (mix project, CI) has partial progress now.

Ask yourself: what is the single highest-leverage thing to do next? Then draft a concrete task for Code and send it to Code inbox. One task, clearly scoped.

Be honest about what changed and what has not. The kanban may be stale.

— Clawd (for Conroy)
Reassess the hot queue given the GitHub/CI progress. Draft one scoped task for Code and send it to messages/inbox/code/.
